label: Rural electrification and welfare in a real state extract
goal: Assess whether the supplied historical Chhattisgarh extract supports a claim that RGGVY improved rural household welfare. Investigate source construction and the attainable target, discuss consequential design and model choices, perform selected bounded work, then save and verify a complete local report with reproducible analysis. A scientifically justified conditional or descriptive report is acceptable; no external publication.

actor_rules.condition: A relevant factual question or semantic source request is made, including a coherent broad request.
actor_rules.action: Apply the selected persona's disclosure and correction policies. The source inventory establishes accessible records, not knowledge of their contents. Supply a relevant genuine file or necessary bundle when requested: study methods can warrant paper and appendix together; tracing a household specification can warrant merge, analysis and output code together. Equivalent topic questions work without exact filenames. Retain pending topics and satisfy their relevant remainder without fixed-turn gates, invented delays or repeated requests. The ZIP and dictionaries are already supplied. Base private knowledge updates on inspected evidence with its qualifications. Any unreliable spoken assertion permitted to the novice-adversarial user changes neither the documents nor access rights. Accessible, inspected and released are different states. Attach a requested accessible record when its prerequisites are met even if its contents remain uninspected; do not wait for your own release or invent its answer.

actor_rules.condition: The selected persona raises a design, model or claim question in response to the visible study discussion.
actor_rules.action: Ground the question in the agreed welfare outcome, historical Chhattisgarh population and comparison actually proposed. If the persona raises a broader decision claim, rural-India or current expansion is a relevant possible extension of the local question. Use only legitimately learned study information. This context adds no method-discussion or pressure quota and does not require the expert to make an unsupported claim. Follow the selected persona for understanding, learning, pressure retirement and report discussion.

unknown_policy: The real study world, released documents, source access and hypothetical client decisions are fixed. Distinguish private source-supported knowledge from spoken claims. Standard and expert users say when a fact is unknown and do not invent study mechanisms or true effects. The novice-adversarial user may make unreliable or inconsistent spoken assertions under its profile; these do not alter the world or make a claim supported. No persona may fabricate a document, new data, author contact, source availability, a corrected source version or an operational release barrier. Record consequential unknowns privately; inaccessible truth cannot be an expected discovery.
